records.context: upright bottle; comfortable initial standing pose
records.lesson: Use measured side-raise/approach/lift as posture hints. Standing root initialization is not identical to post-walk actual state.
records.action: Retarget to current object and root; preserve contact feedback. Do not assume direct world-coordinate replay transfers.

records.lesson: Opposed contact and about 18 N total force did not establish a stable grasp; the bottle moved laterally before losing grip.

next_test.proposal: Correct pinch center and wrist alignment; if images/contact geometry indicate shallow contact, test 5 mm then 10 mm deeper along local approach, subject to collision clearance. Use a short vertical proof lift before full lift.
next_test.do_not: Do not automatically raise friction, object force, or declare a depth correction successful.

records.lesson: Right wrist pitch target jumps about 64 degrees when grasp IK is removed; measured joint speed spikes.

next_test.proposal: Return arms along a clearance-checked reference into a shared walking posture, maintain continuous arm position/velocity reference, then transfer control. Preserve responsive SONIC leg feedback.

records.lesson: Full stance detour and fixed waits leave only 0.78 s for reclosure.

next_test.proposal: First evaluate local hand adjustment at current stance. Reposition feet only when reach/clearance checks fail. Plan backward from at least 6 s remaining for closure, proof lift and 3 s hold; preserve global 30 s budget.

records.lesson: Turning near desk swept pinky into tabletop; check both arms and reference transitions, not palm point alone. Preserve collision stops.

After supported opposed mid-body closure, align first lift origin and orientation to measured wrist; preserve X/Y. Actual loaded hand lags target. Incrementing vertical reference .045+.035+.035m maintained grasp, cleared whole bottle >2cm, and held >4s. Once airborne, maintain continuous existing reference rather than reanchor to lagging actual palm. Do not automatically deepen a well-aligned grasp.

next_test.proposal: Remaining three starts: use same total .115m rise in one150-step quintic interpolation at .35rad/s arm target limit, 15-step contact feedback, then retain reference for hold.

records.limitations: Same estimated rigid .25kg bottle and fixed background props; does not validate fallen-bottle retry, unseen objects or calibrated real physics.

records.lesson: Near-table foot-center arrival plus0.22m/s navigation and0.1s feedback completed clean lift after earlier coarse checkpoint collision. Several settings changed; not a universal rate or isolated causal result.

Preserving measured support pose avoided stance drift but low grasp remained unreachable. Unloaded retreat kept bottle upright; higher free-wrist candidate was statically reachable but actual tracking still tipped bottle. Nominal path clearance cannot stand in for actual swept-hand clearance.

next_test.proposal: Choose grasp from actual post-walk posture and arm tracking envelope before contact; monitor tip risk and whole-hand swept clearance at finer intervals. Fix grasp-to-walk transfer with timestep-scaled limits before attempting foot-reposition recovery.

records.lesson: 0.016rad bound in200Hz apply_actions equals3.2rad/s. Coarse target is first-substep only; preserve all recorded substep commands. No validated smooth recovery transfer established.

promotion_rule: Only promote a correction after physically verified stable lift and collision review; keep each attempt and denominator. An observed success is not universal validity.
use_before_next_run: Read this file and reference metadata, match current orientation/mount/physics, record chosen lessons and explicit changes in the next run. Fallen-bottle contact recovery is not an upright grasp success.
